title: Refactor detail item interactions to use ItemIndex
description: Update the detail screen and row component so checklist interactions operate on `ShoppingListEntry` plus `ItemIndex` rather than line indices from parsed text.
acceptance_criteria: `ShoppingListItemRow` accepts structured entry data and no longer depends on `ShoppingListItem.lineIndex`.
`ShoppingListDetailView` toggles, updates, and removes items by `ItemIndex` and persists via `renderMarkdown()`.
Search and per-item actions continue to work against structured entry text.

handoff_summary.completed: - ShoppingListItemRow: replaced `let item: ShoppingListItem` with `let entry: ShoppingListEntry`; updated all item.checked/item.text references to entry.checked/entry.text; updated preview to use ShoppingListEntry initializer.\n- ShoppingListDetailView: replaced `@State private var list = ShoppingList("")` with `@State private var document = ShoppingListDocument()`; replaced ShoppingListAisleGrouper-based groups with document.aisles via a private IndexedEntry struct that carries ItemIndex + ShoppingListEntry; updated checkedCount/totalCount to flatMap over document.aisles; updated filteredGroups to preserve original aisle positions when filtering; updated toggleItem/deleteItem/updateItem to call document.toggle/removeItem/updateItem(at:) with ItemIndex; updated save() to write document.renderMarkdown(); updated .task to parse text into ShoppingListDocument(markdown:); updated ShoppingListHeaderExtractor call to pass document.renderMarkdown(); updated AddItemSheet callback to assign updated document directly.
handoff_summary.risks: None identified. ShoppingListAisleGrouper is no longer used by ShoppingListDetailView but remains in the codebase — a follow-up cleanup bead could remove it if no other callers exist.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent to verify toggle, update, and delete interactions via ItemIndex, and that search filtering preserves correct original positions.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: ShoppingListAisleGrouper is now unused by the app but still present — a sibling bead touching that file would be a no-op conflict risk only.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used a private IndexedEntry struct (carrying ItemIndex + ShoppingListEntry) inside ShoppingListDetailView so that filtered groups preserve the original aisle position for correct ItemIndex construction. ForEach uses id: \\.index.position which is unique within each aisle group.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Toggle, update, and delete paths all exercise ShoppingListDocument mutations (toggle/updateItem/removeItem at ItemIndex) and persist via renderMarkdown(). Search filtering correctly carries original positions so post-filter mutations target the right entries.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: ShoppingListAisleGrouper is now dead code — it is no longer called by ShoppingListDetailView. It can be removed in a follow-up cleanup bead.

conflict_risks: ShoppingListAisleGrouper is now unused by the app but still present — a sibling bead touching that file would be a no-op conflict risk only.

execution_history.summary: Refactored ShoppingListItemRow and ShoppingListDetailView to operate on ShoppingListEntry + ItemIndex rather than line-indexed ShoppingListItem. The detail view now holds a ShoppingListDocument as state, groups items directly from document aisles, and persists via renderMarkdown(). The row component now accepts ShoppingListEntry (text + checked) with no lineIndex dependency. Build succeeds.
